#!/bin/bash
wump_evidence=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-native-select
wump_stock=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-7a16547/stock/perl/perl-5.42.2/perl
wump_go=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-runtime-owner/integration/matrix-go
wump_before=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-yield-wake/integration/perl/perl-5.42.2/perl
wump_after="$wump_evidence/integration/perl/perl-5.42.2/perl"
export LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Refusing timing capture with dirty sources.' >&2; exit 1; fi
for wump_role in before current; do
	if [ "$wump_role" = before ]; then wump_binary=$wump_before; else wump_binary=$wump_after; fi
	if ! taskset -c 0,2,4,6 perl bench/matrix.pl "$wump_binary" "$wump_stock" "$wump_go" --runs 5 --iterations 50000 --jobs 8 --output "$wump_evidence/matrix-$wump_role.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-$wump_role.md" 2> "$wump_evidence/matrix-$wump_role.stderr"; then
		printf 'Matrix capture failed: %s\n' "$wump_role" >&2; exit 1
	fi
done
perl bench/matrix-check.pl "$wump_evidence/matrix-before.json" "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-check.txt"
wump_fresh=$?
perl bench/matrix-check.pl bench/operation-matrix-callee-baseline.json "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-anchor-check.txt"
wump_anchor=$?
printf 'Fresh gate exit: %s; retained-anchor gate exit: %s\n' "$wump_fresh" "$wump_anchor"
if [ "$wump_fresh" -ne 0 ] || [ "$wump_anchor" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
